about: Curated stops for the Northeast legs (missing roads pass, 2026-11-23), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Started from the stops the region's existing legs carry with a position and a source, so a stop on a shared road lands on a new leg too; heading for those was derived from the side the old leg placed them on (the leg's own direction of travel at the stop). lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. Stops for the new legs were added from the OpenStreetMap planet file of 2026-11-16: named truck stops and service plazas, named rest areas, designated truck parking, and named diesel stations within 0.15 mile of the road, at most one diesel station per 12 miles where nothing else stood, and on links still 55 miles or more between fuel, a brand station in a town, its diesel assumed where the map is silent (said in its source); side from a name ("South Bound", "SB") or from the side of the divided road the stop lies on. A stop with a heading lands on a leg stored the other way with directions reverse.

truck_access.about: Stops added in this pass whose tractor-trailer access was read from OpenStreetMap's hgv tag, and those where it is assumed with the reason in source: rest areas and truck stops with no hgv tag, and town diesel stations, which are marked bobtail only. The stops carried over from the region's existing legs keep their own sources.
